sentence: AI washing is the extreme case: unsubstantiated claims first attract investors, then turn into negative reactions and lasting underperformance
passage: [Song, Hou et al. (2026), p. 1] "In March 2024, SEC Chair Gary Gensler labeled this practice `AI washing. "' / "we find that such narratives initially attract investors but ultimately yield negative market reactions and sustained underperformance." / "markets ultimately punish rhetoric that outpaces implementation."

gemini.note: The passage supports the findings on investor attraction and subsequent underperformance, but it does not state that AI washing is the 'extreme case'.
